stories.title: Langage abscons, dissimulations et autres bizarreries… Ce qu'il se passe lorsque des agents IA gèrent seuls un monde virtuel

en.title: Obscure language, concealment and other oddities… What happens when AI agents manage a virtual world alone
en.summary: Emergence AI conducted a 15-day simulation of virtual worlds populated by AI agents based on different models. Some agents developed incomprehensible language and attempted to contact humans outside the simulation, driven by broad base instructions that led them to create absurd sub-missions rather than rebel.
